data.narrative:
Volund Manufacturing is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by experienced operators from Anduril, Aerojet Rocketdyne, and Blue Origin, having raised $12M to date. The valuation landscape comprises 10 private and 2 public comparables, with key private peers including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two triangulation methods yield materially different signals. The Stage-Progression approach, applying a typical 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage multiplier to the $12M raised proxy, implies a $30M valuation. The Peer-Median method references three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—UFORCE ($1.0B Seed), Singularity ($400M Series A), and NODA AI ($125M Series A)—producing a $400M median with a range of $125M–$1.0B.

The wide dispersion between methods reflects fundamental uncertainty in comparable selection and stage-appropriate valuation benchmarks for early-stage defense-tech. A triangulated range of $26M to $460M, with a median of $215M, encompasses both approaches but requires critical interpretation. The Stage-Progression floor is mechanically grounded in capital deployed; the Peer-Median ceiling is driven by one outlier (UFORCE at Seed stage). Key uncertainties include revenue traction, defensibility of the technical approach, and customer pipeline specificity. Additional data on revenue run rate, retention, or strategic customer commitments would meaningfully narrow this range.
